SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.65

Reconcile helper: a journal entry for each ticked line, recorded at once, each filled in from its own bank rule (lines that aren’t a bank charge or interest, or have no known account, are left for you).
One journal entry for the ticked lines uses each line’s own rule; the journal entry says which rules filled it in; the line’s hint shows the account its rule posts to.
Fixed: the Reconcile helper stays on the same page and place after an action.

Includes everything from 2.0.0-beta.56 to 64.
